meta.odds_refresh_policy: Free beta: score snapshots follow the scheduled worker and live ML odds are rate-guarded. Commercial point-by-point operation requires a licensed low-latency feed.
meta.score_contract: Set/game state is parsed only from unambiguous structured period fields. Point score is never fabricated.
